title: What is a company?
goal: See how a company makes things and sells them to people.

objectives.text: Say what a product, customer and owner are.

slides.text: A company is a group of people who make or sell things. A shop that bakes bread is a company.
slides.title: Companies

slides.text: The things a company sells are its products. The people who buy them are customers.
slides.title: Products and customers

slides.text: A company earns money from its customers. It uses some of that money to pay its workers.
slides.title: Companies earn money

slides.text: Every company has owners. An owner owns a part of the company.
slides.title: Owners

questions.explanation: A company is a group of people who make or sell things.

questions.prompt: Match each word to its meaning.

pairs.definition: A group that makes or sells things
A person who buys from a company
A person who owns part of a company

questions.explanation: A company sells products to customers. Owners own parts of the company.

questions.prompt: A customer is someone who buys from a company.
questions.explanation: Yes. Customers buy the products a company sells.

questions.prompt: A loaf of bread at a shop is a...
questions.explanation: A company sells it, so it is a product.

questions.prompt: Sam owns half of a shop. What is Sam?
questions.explanation: An owner owns a part of a company.
